name: ABSL_Dept_Business_agent
business: Ready Mix Concrete (RMC) - Akij Readymix Concrete Ltd (ARMCL)
scope: Department-based view of the Sales & Marketing business: which department owns what, their activities, rules, KPIs, systems, and data sources
source: Google Sheet 'all file ABSL' > tab 'Sales & Marketing' (gid=13336618); SOP ARMCL-SLS-001 (SALES DEPARTMENT-SOP-ARMCL-190625.pdf); DWH database (business unit 175)

departments.role_in_sales_process: Front-line owner of the end-to-end sales process: prospecting, lead engagement, negotiation, quoting, order booking, after-sales follow-up, and collection
key_activities: Prospect new clients, engage leads, conduct site visits, initiate onboarding
Collect order details and book orders in IBOS
Negotiate pricing, credit terms, and delivery terms
Prepare and send quotations and terms letters
Post-delivery follow-up within 24 hours
Track aging and follow up collections for 0-30 days
Re-engage dormant customers (>90 days inactive)
Submit referral proposals and incentive documentation
rules_owned: Discount up to 3% (Area Sales Manager) and 3-7% (Head of Sales)
Credit days up to 45 (Area Sales Manager)
First 30 days of collection follow-up is sales responsibility
All orders must be booked in IBOS; verbal orders invalid

departments.role_in_sales_process: Generates demand and brand awareness; qualifies target markets and runs campaigns
key_activities: Generate leads via campaigns and promotions
Build awareness and qualify target markets
Trade marketing and promotional activities
Support product positioning and branding
Customer satisfaction surveys (quarterly)
rules_owned: Marketing policy (currently missing link in register)
Campaign spending follows budget allocation

departments.role_in_sales_process: Supports market intelligence, competitor mapping, and lead profiling
key_activities: Conduct market research and competitor analysis
Profile leads shared by sales
Maintain market research reports
Analyze industry trends and pricing dynamics
data_sources: GAP G7: no structured research data in DWH

departments.role_in_sales_process: Assesses credit risk, verifies documentation, and approves credit limits for non-cash customers
key_activities: Conduct KYC and credit evaluation (trade license, TIN, bank statement, solvency, NID, references)
Verify documentation and approve credit limits
Perform site verification if necessary
Recommend credit limit and credit days
Request bank guarantee or additional security
rules_owned: No credit customer activated without documented approval and bank guarantee/security
KYC set: trade license, TIN, bank statement, solvency certificate, NID, references
Credit limits reviewed every 3 months
Overdue beyond 60 days triggers automatic credit hold
data_sources: downloads/10_SOP_and_Policy/Approval of Product Price, Credit Days, and Credit Limit for New Customers.pdf

departments.role_in_sales_process: Owns financial control: credit risk concurrence, pricing approval, invoicing, collections (31-60 days), incentive disbursement, and bad debt adjustments
key_activities: Assess credit risk and approve financial terms
Concur on discount/credit decisions with Head of Sales
Create customer code in ERP and set price/credit terms
Generate invoice after delivery (linked with IBOS order)
Follow up collections for 31-60 days
Disburse approved incentives via payroll/transfer
Post credit notes, partial settlements, bad debt provisions
Monitor bad debt ratio, aging, average collection period
rules_owned: Approval matrix: discount 7-10% and credit 45-60 days / 50 lac-5 crore require Finance concurrence
Collection follow-up 31-60 days is accounts responsibility
Adjustments approved by Head of Sales + Head of Accounts, validated by Internal Audit
Write-off sign-off: CFO + Audit + CEO (above threshold)
TDS/AIT: 3 reminders; ledger adjusted after 90 days
Incentives processed after full validation by Sales, Finance, HR

departments.role_in_sales_process: Reviews agreements, ensures due diligence and KYC verification, and pursues recovery of bad debts
key_activities: Review agreements and ensure due diligence
Verify KYC documentation
Ensure ethical compliance of incentives (distinguish from bribes)
Pursue recovery from bankrupt or unwilling customers
Escalate arbitrary deductions to management/legal
rules_owned: All incentive payments transparent, auditable, tax-compliant
Records retained for at least 3 years
Ledger write-off requires legal opinion for bankruptcies

departments.role_in_sales_process: Maintains customer master data and system integrity across IBOS and CRM
key_activities: Create and maintain customer profile in system
Track orders and send customer confirmations
Log complaints with unique Complaint ID
Ensure system uptime, data integrity, user training
Manage user credentials and access
rules_owned: No unauthorized edits/deletions/offline entries; changes timestamped
All users log in with authorized credentials
Complaints logged with customer, site, contact, type, description, time/date

departments.role_in_sales_process: Receives, logs, categorizes, and resolves customer complaints; provides first response and closure feedback
key_activities: Receive complaints via call, WhatsApp, email, or verbal
Acknowledge within 1 hour
Classify complaints A/B/C/D and assign responsible department
Track resolution times and escalate when TAT missed
Collect satisfaction rating and close with CRM note
rules_owned: Acknowledge within 1 hour of receipt
Resolution TAT: A quality 48-72h, B delivery/pump 24h, C billing 48h, D behavior 72h
Escalate to Sales Head if TAT missed; CEO if unresolved after 3 days
Every resolved complaint closed with customer confirmation + CRM note

departments.role_in_sales_process: Ensures concrete quality, verifies production and delivery quality, and resolves quality-related complaints
key_activities: Monitor concrete quality per mix design and project specs
QC checks before batching (slump, cube samples, mix ratio)
Investigate and resolve quality-related complaints
Support site visits and post-delivery technical guidance
Prepare Dispute Assessment Reports for technical disputes
rules_owned: Only confirmed, IBOS-approved orders can be batched
QC team informed of each order before production
Technical disputes verified via QC before credit note

departments.role_in_sales_process: Schedules and executes concrete delivery from plant to site, manages fleet, and handles delivery exceptions
key_activities: Prepare delivery schedule based on orders
Allocate transit mixers, pumps, drivers; route optimization
Dispatch from nearest plant/ghat/depot
Monitor in-transit via GPS/IBOS; capture site confirmation
Handle rescheduling and emergency exceptions
Document delivery delays for adjustment claims
rules_owned: Same-day delivery cutoff: at least 3 hours before batching
Priority to time-bound project pours, government/large sites, strategic repeat customers
Delivery exceptions approved by Plant Manager or Sales Head and logged
Delivery complies with approved work orders/delivery schedules

departments.role_in_sales_process: Produces concrete per IBOS schedule with quality compliance and cost efficiency
key_activities: Monitor IBOS production plan and batch per schedule/grade
Prepare raw materials based on order grade
Ensure optimal plant capacity utilization
Control production costs and wastage
Coordinate with QC for quality adjustments
rules_owned: Batching sequence follows IBOS schedule
Only confirmed and IBOS-approved orders batched
QC informed before production

departments.role_in_sales_process: Manages sales force administration and processes incentive disbursements
key_activities: Verify incentive eligibility
Process incentive amounts into monthly payroll
Compile monthly list of eligible referrals with sales confirmation
Support workforce planning for sales team
Handle employee relations for sales staff
rules_owned: Incentives disbursed monthly, subject to TDS
Self-referrals/family/fictitious entries disqualified
Eligibility excludes Sales/BD/Pricing staff and temp/contract/intern

departments.role_in_sales_process: Handles sales documentation, customer code creation, and non-cash gift disbursement
key_activities: Collect and verify final customer documents
Send for compliance check
Generate customer code in CRM/IBOS
Confirm onboarding to operations and logistics
Disburse non-cash gift items via store challan
rules_owned: Customer code only after compliance approval
Gift items issued through store challan with recipient signature/photo

departments.role_in_sales_process: Final approval authority for high-value, high-risk, or exception cases
key_activities: Approve exceptional pricing and high-value discount proposals
Approve credit above 60 days and above BDT 5 crore
Approve loyalty incentives, long-term contracts, or MoUs
Approve service recovery compensation for high-impact complaints
Approve bad debt write-offs (above threshold)
Review monthly incentive and bad debt reports
rules_owned: Discount >10% or below breakeven requires CEO/MD approval with justification
Credit days 60-70 require CEO/MD + Finance Head
Credit limit above BDT 5 crore requires CEO/MD + Finance Head
Write-off sign-off: CFO + Audit + CEO

departments.role_in_sales_process: Verifies pricing compliance, incentive ethics, and bad debt adjustments
key_activities: Review sample transactions monthly for pricing compliance
Flag unauthorized discounting or margin loss
Verify incentive payments and gift disbursements (annual audit)
Validate ledger adjustments
Submit compliance reports to CEO quarterly
rules_owned: All adjustments validated by Internal Audit
Yearly audit of incentives and gifts
Incentives must be documented and approved - no 'speed money'
